title: Document list and wrapped federation snapshot refusal statuses
outcome: The federation link feature documentation distinguishes the single-peer snapshot helper's 409/423/409 statuses from the peer-list read's 409 and callers that wrap or replace refusals, without implying all settling text reaches callers as HTTP423.
acceptance: The federation-link documentation states that the peer-list read retains HTTP409 for the shared cause texts and distinguishes direct single-peer helper statuses from wrappers that re-map or replace them, using the actual production callers as evidence.
The documentation avoids promising that every snapshot caller preserves the helper status or message and changes no production authority, admission, persistence, retry or status behavior.
